name: opencode-poteto-mode
description: An OpenCode V2 adaptation of pstack and Poteto Mode

scripts.test: bun test src && bun test skills/poteto-mode/scripts/orch skills/poteto-mode/scripts/watch-pr
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc --ignoreConfig --noEmit --strict --target ESNext --module Preserve --moduleResolution bundler --allowImportingTsExtensions --types bun skills/poteto-mode/scripts/orch/orch.ts skills/poteto-mode/scripts/orch/store.ts && tsc --project skills/poteto-mode/scripts/watch-pr/tsconfig.json --noEmit --strict
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bash -n skills/poteto-mode/scripts/worktree-audit.sh
